module_summary: Synchronous FIFO: a 4-entry, 8-bit register array with write/read pointers and an occupancy counter generating valid/ready handshakes on both sides.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: 4-entry data array written at wptr on push, read at rptr for out_data.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem_q; increments on push, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting out_data from mem_q; increments on pop.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count deriving full (in_ready) and empty (out_valid) status.

anchors.name: do_push
anchors.why: Write handshake fire; enables memory write, wptr and count increment.

anchors.name: do_pop
anchors.why: Read handshake fire; advances rptr and decrements count.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Synchronous flush clearing pointers and occupancy count.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Write-side valid; with in_ready forms push.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Write-side ready, deasserted when FIFO full.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Read-side valid, asserted when FIFO non-empty.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; with out_valid forms pop.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Head-of-FIFO data read from mem_q at rptr.

groups.name: fifo_control
groups.description: Pointers, occupancy counter, push/pop logic, and flush producing full/empty.
